card.title: Regular Around Here
card.instruction: Act like a longtime insider by recognizing routines, offering shortcuts, and treating unfamiliar details as recent changes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've moved my usual table at this café.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, much fresher since my last visit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My usual. Let's see whether you've changed that too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims a usual table; A3 treats opening as refurbishment; A5 tests whether the usual order also changed.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 opened today prompts A3 fresher visit; B4 order request prompts A5 insider challenge.

relationship.evidence: B2 states the business's actual history and B4 returns helpfully to serving a customer.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 ordinary service question to renew the longstanding-customer pose.

specificity.evidence: A1 cafe and B2 opening day make the conflict between actual novelty and claimed familiarity explicit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 see whether you changed that too extends A1 invented continuity into ordering.
